why: Image 2 reads as a real room at night: the dark smoked-glass globe sits quietly under the beams, and the soft window-shaped wash across the concrete wall looks like light that is really there, so the eye goes to the bar, the stools and the glowing table lamps. In Image 1 the saturated RGB neon rings and the rainbow patch they throw on the wall look like a CG prop pasted into the frame, which breaks the photographic illusion in an otherwise identical composition.
